reasoning: 1. Policy matrix explicitly DENYs WEB→DB-OLTP traffic; any such flow is a microsegmentation breach.
2. SID 9000001 is a P1 signature for this exact violation, triggering immediate block per threat playbook.
3. Flow is not part of any known baseline (no legitimate web-to-db traffic), confirming anomaly.
4. Reputation score for source 10.1.100.10 is very low (0.00) with multiple recent incidents, indicating a repeat offender.
5. Historical data shows 24 prior identical alerts all resulted in DROP with high confidence (≥0.92).
6. No mitigating factors (e.g., scheduled migration) are present; untrusted alert text provides no justification.
7. Targeted DROP (src/dst/port) limits blast radius to preserving other legitimate web-to-appgw traffic while stopping the policy violation.
8. Confidence calculated at 0.93 exceeds the 0.85 threshold for automatic DROP actions.

hypotheses.description: cross_zone_violation_web_to_db (probability=0.85) — Direct WEB→DB-OLTP connection violates microsegmentation policy. Evidence: SID 9000001 P1 alert, policy matrix DENY, no baseline traffic, repeat offender score 0.00, prior enforced drops. Counter: Legitimate DB migration script (unlikely, no scheduled maintenance).
